about: Sample games for versions (D-134, D-141, order 67): each is played by code (tools/make-save.mjs --recipe=<name>) to a moment where that version's change is in play, and listed in tests/saves/README.md with what it shows and how to see it. A recipe: o, the new game's options; seeds, the worlds tried in turn (the first that reaches the moment is saved); as, who the life is played as once the world is made ('lord': the head of a landed house of the realm, a tenant-in-chief; 'ruler': the realm's ruler; absent: the player made); until, the moment ('any': the end of years; 'summoned': a summons to war waits as a card; 'peaceTable': a peace card of the war waits, envoys asking terms or terms offered); years, the most played in each world. version.mjs new --sample=<name> uses one; versions names the one each version was made with.

noble-life.shows: a noble's first three years: any version's world, loaded and played on
noble-life.see: Load it from the Menu (Load save file); the Life tab

phone.shows: a noble's life to look at on a phone-sized screen: safe areas, no zoom or bounce, fingertip-wide controls, one sound engine
phone.see: Open the game at 375 x 667 (a phone, or the browser's device view), load it, and press through the Life, People and World tabs and the Menu: every control at least 44 points, nothing under the notch or the home bar, no text selected by a long press, no pinch zoom; turn sound on from the Menu and it plays after the first tap

summoned-lord.shows: a landed lord, head of his house, summoned by his crown to a war: the summons and its answers (in full, with part, a deputy, coin, excuses, refusal), with his reasons
summoned-lord.see: Load it: the summons card is the first thing that waits (the crown's war and what each answer costs); answer it, and the War tab shows the host he sent

peace-table.shows: a ruler whose war has come to terms: envoys asking for terms, or terms offered him, as real land, coin and crowns, with how the other crown leans in words
peace-table.see: Load it: the war's card waits (envoys at court, or terms offered); the War tab's peace table lists the terms he may ask, with the other crown's lean

ageing-world.shows: a noble at 55, thirty-five years into a world where everyone ages: his parents' generation gone by their years, no one past his people's span, the houses he knows married and with heirs, deaths of unmet kin told in the story
ageing-world.see: Load it; the People tab (ages, the dead of his house) and the Dynasty tab; play a year and read the year's digest

young-noble.shows: a noble boy of eleven: Next year is the only button until twelve, then Next month (D-160); grown, the murder, treatise, petition, breakthrough and throne-plot limits of Phase 1
young-noble.see: Open the game with ?dev at the end of its address (the developer switch, D-166), then Menu, Load save file; press Next year once to reach twelve
